name: WSH Bulk Price Manager for WooCommerce
author: Web Solutions Hub · websolutions.online

sections.description:
WSH Bulk Price Manager for WooCommerce is a WooCommerce bulk price editor for safely updating product prices directly from WordPress.

Instead of opening products one by one, select the products you want to change, choose a percentage or fixed price adjustment, preview the results, and apply the update in bulk.

You can bulk increase or decrease regular prices, existing sale prices, or both. Products can be filtered by category, tag, or attribute, and variable product variations can be included in the update.

Before any price is changed, the plugin provides a preview showing the current and calculated prices. After applying an update, the most recent bulk price operation can be undone if necessary.

WooCommerce is required. The free plugin is fully functional on its own and does not require an account, license key, or connection to WPPluginsPRO.

WooCommerce Bulk Price Editor

Managing prices individually can become time-consuming as a WooCommerce catalog grows.

WSH Bulk Price Manager lets you create a pricing rule and apply it to all matching products in one operation.

For example, you can:

  • Increase prices in a product category by 5%
  • Decrease selected product prices by 10%
  • Add a fixed amount to regular prices
  • Reduce prices by a fixed amount
  • Update regular prices and existing sale prices together
  • Update matching variations of variable products
  • Preview calculated prices before saving anything

There is no product-count limit on bulk updates in the free plugin.

Percentage and Fixed Price Changes

Choose between percentage-based and fixed-amount adjustments.

Percentage examples:

  • Increase $100 by 10% → $110
  • Decrease $100 by 10% → $90

Fixed amount examples:

  • Increase $100 by $5 → $105
  • Decrease $100 by $5 → $95

The plugin prevents calculated prices from being saved below zero.

Filter WooCommerce Products

Choose which products should be included before running a bulk price update.

The free version supports filtering by:

  • Product category
  • Product tag
  • Product attribute and value
  • Simple products and matching variations

If no category or tag is selected, products are not restricted by that filter.

The preview lets you verify the products and calculated prices before applying the operation.

Update Regular and Sale Prices

Choose which WooCommerce price fields should be changed:

  • Regular price
  • Existing sale price
  • Regular and existing sale price

The free plugin does not automatically create a new sale price when a product does not already have one.

This helps keep standard bulk price adjustments predictable.

Creating or updating sale prices from regular prices using discount logic is available in the separate PRO add-on.

Variable Product Price Updates

Variable WooCommerce products are supported.

Enable matching variations when you want the pricing operation to include individual variations that meet your selected filters.

Preview the results before applying the update to verify which prices will change.

Preview Before Updating Prices

Price changes should not be a guessing game.

Click Preview Price Changes to calculate the proposed changes without modifying WooCommerce product data.

The preview shows the first 200 matching products for a responsive admin experience.

This is only a preview display limit.

When you apply the update, the free plugin processes every product that matches your filters. There is no 200-product update limit.

Safe Bulk Price Updates

The workflow is designed to make large price changes easier to verify before they are committed.

The free plugin includes:

  • Preview before applying changes
  • Explicit confirmation before prices are modified
  • Validation of calculated prices
  • Protection against negative prices
  • Undo for the most recent bulk price update

Products outside the selected filters are not part of the pricing operation.

Undo the Last Bulk Price Update

If you need to reverse the most recent bulk price operation, use the built-in undo feature.

The free version keeps the information required to restore prices from the latest bulk update.

Multiple restore points and extended pricing history are available in the separate PRO add-on.

CSV Price Export

Export current WooCommerce product prices to CSV for review, backup, or spreadsheet workflows.

The free plugin includes:

  • CSV template download
  • Current-price CSV export

CSV/Excel price import is not included in the free plugin and is available through the separate PRO add-on.

Free Features

  • Bulk edit WooCommerce product prices
  • Bulk update simple products and variations
  • Percentage price increases
  • Percentage price decreases
  • Fixed-amount price increases
  • Fixed-amount price decreases
  • Category filters
  • Product tag filters
  • Product attribute filtering
  • Regular price updates
  • Existing sale price updates
  • Update regular and existing sale prices together
  • Preview before saving price changes
  • Explicit confirmation before applying updates
  • Undo the most recent bulk update
  • CSV template download
  • Current-price CSV export
  • Protection against negative prices
  • No product-count limit for bulk updates
  • No account required
  • No license required

WSH Bulk Price Manager for WooCommerce PRO

Need scheduling, imports, advanced filtering, reusable pricing rules, or additional restore points?

WSH Bulk Price Manager for WooCommerce PRO is a separate add-on that extends the free plugin.

PRO adds:

  • Smart Sale Price tools
  • Advanced product filters
  • AND/OR filtering options
  • Multiple attribute values
  • Scheduled price updates
  • CSV and Excel-compatible price import
  • Saved pricing presets
  • Multiple restore points
  • Extended pricing history
  • Price rounding options
  • Batch processing for large catalogs
  • Priority support

The PRO implementation is contained in the separate add-on. The free plugin does not require PRO and continues to work independently.

Built for WooCommerce Stores

WSH Bulk Price Manager is useful for stores that regularly need to adjust product pricing without editing products individually.

Typical workflows include:

  • Seasonal price adjustments
  • Supplier cost increases
  • Category-wide price changes
  • Brand or attribute-based pricing changes
  • Catalog-wide percentage adjustments
  • Regular and sale price maintenance
  • Variable product price updates
  • Reviewing current prices in CSV

Developed by Web Solutions Hub

sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Install and activate WSH Bulk Price Manager for WooCommerce.
  3. Open WooCommerce → Bulk Price Manager.
  4. Select the products you want to update.
  5. Choose a percentage or fixed price adjustment.
  6. Select which price fields should be changed.
  7. Click Preview Price Changes.
  8. Review the calculated prices.
  9. Confirm and apply the bulk update.
sections.faq:
Can I bulk edit WooCommerce product prices?

Yes. Select products using the available filters, choose a percentage or fixed adjustment, preview the calculated prices, and apply the update.

Can I increase WooCommerce prices by a percentage?

Yes. Choose Percentage and Increase, then enter the percentage you want to apply.

For example, a 10% increase changes a $100 price to $110.

Can I bulk update sale prices?

Yes. The free plugin can update existing sale prices.

It does not create a new sale price for products that do not already have one. Smart Sale Price functionality is available in the separate PRO add-on.

Does it support variable products?

Yes. Matching product variations can be included in bulk price operations.

Does the free plugin limit how many products can be updated?

No.

The preview displays the first 200 matching products to keep the admin interface responsive, but the actual update processes every product matching the selected filters.

Can I undo a bulk price change?

Yes. The free plugin can restore prices from the most recent bulk update.

The PRO add-on provides multiple restore points and extended pricing history.

Can I export WooCommerce prices to CSV?

Yes. The free plugin can export current prices for products matching your filters.

Does the plugin require a license?

No. The free plugin works without an account or license key and does not contact a license server.

The separate PRO add-on uses its own commercial license.

Is WooCommerce required?

Yes. WSH Bulk Price Manager for WooCommerce is designed for WooCommerce product pricing and requires WooCommerce.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Initial WordPress.org release of the standalone free plugin.
  • Bulk WooCommerce price increases and decreases using percentages or fixed amounts.
  • Category, tag and attribute filters, including support for matching product variations.
  • Regular price and existing sale price adjustments.
  • Price preview, confirmation and undo for the most recent bulk update.
  • CSV template download and current-price export.
  • No product-count limit on bulk updates; the preview displays up to 200 matching products.
  • Improved input validation and protection against negative prices.
  • Note: Price snapshots and presets saved by version 1.0.0 are not read by this release.

1.0.0

  • First release.
